items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The name 'French' is mentioned by the interviewer ('Oh, French is 12') but the interviewee does not respond to it or mention any personal interaction with a person named French.

ctx.x: I don't have any money, but just the way it sounds. I don't have any money, but just the way it sounds. We'll get it another time. That's right. I really had a sweet man. One of my boys, one of the main hitter boy, got it on. He shot off one that he left on. And so I got another boy, and he sold all the instruments. Sold all the equipment. Sold them on Saturday, on Friday night, we went to go outside the morning and a.m. ever. So the fire was getting on. And everything was going to bring in so many. I got a…
Oh, French is 12. Uh huh. And he's out of. Now, put it down. Let me see how I can put that on. I'll get it back to you. Yeah.
What goes on the white boy? Top of that. What goes on the white boy? Does that put a thing on it? What is it?
